C1.worst_defect: The home page never links to the staff guide 'At the till' (selling, refunds, 'Count the drawer and close the day'): the hero buttons are Live demo / Quick start / Try with your store / GitHub, and the 'Registers and Z reports' card has no link, so an owner asking 'can my staff sell and how do I close the day' has no next click.

C2.worst_defect: Refunds depend on 'the plugin release after 0.3.0, which is not out yet', repeated on home, limitations and at-the-till with no version number or expected date, and the site never says plainly whether a receipt printer or cash drawer works beyond 'print the receipt from the browser'.
C2.where: home text 'Before you start'; limitations; at-the-till (Refund, Receipt)

C3.worst_defect: Quick start step 8 signs in with an admin email and password. The cashier role needs ReadOrder added by hand ('which that role gains only in the plugin release after 0.3.0; until then, add it to the role yourself'), but that is said only on Connect a till, so a freelancer following the quick start for a cashier login hits it unwarned.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.03 / phone.07-08 step 8; connect-a-till 'Give each cashier their own account'

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting 'Sell while offline' says everything works offline 'once the catalogue has synced' but never says whether the till reopens after a browser reload or a restart with no connection. That is the first thing a shop owner asks. Also 'Hand over signs you out and leaves the drawer open' is ambiguous: the register session or the physical drawer?

C5.worst_defect: On every desktop docs page the grey sidebar panel stops at about 900 px with the GitHub/theme bar, leaving a lighter strip down the left below it, which looks unfinished. The hero till screenshot's text is also too small to read at 1440.
C5.where: plugin-setup / notifications / connect-a-till / changelog desktop.01 (left column below ~900 px); home.desktop.01 hero image

C6.worst_defect: The hero till screenshot shrinks to an unreadable thumbnail on a 390 px phone, so the one picture of what staff will use shows nothing. Otherwise tables stack, code wraps and nothing overflows.

C7.worst_defect: The share card is text only ('Point of sale for Vendure' with the ring logo) and shows no till, so a link shared to a shop owner in chat shows nothing of the product. Lighthouse 98-99, titles, descriptions, JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, the search API and the 404 are all present.

overall_worst.defect: The home page has no route to 'At the till', the one page that answers a shop owner's real questions (how staff sell, refund, hand over and close the day with an X/Z report); every home link points at developer setup, GitHub tests or npm.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.01/02 hero buttons and 'Registers and Z reports' card; tech.json home links
overall_worst.fix: Make the 'Registers and Z reports' card link to /docs/at-the-till, and add one line under 'Before you start': 'For staff: At the till — selling, refunds and closing the day.'
